text:
maria_ops: FYI planning to unpin runtime 3.2.1 from hosted canary tonight 22:00 UTC. Perf tests showed slow warmup on some long-prefix workloads — kv-cache hit ramp is taking longer than expected.

deploy-bot: Unpin request queued by @maria_ops for 2026-03-21T22:00Z. Please ack with region staging preferences.

kevin_release: Ack. Staging? also need rollback criteria spelled out.

sam_runtime: Propose staged rollout: eu-west -> us-west -> eu-central with 15m gaps. Rollback if 95p latency >20% over baseline OR cold-start QPS drops >30% for 10m.

jessica_qa: Staggered is good. I'll run the perf harness and smoke prompts after each stage and post the summary here.

maria_ops: Adding a preflight: enable kvcache_preload flag on canary runtime to mitigate slow warmup. We'll also set canary capacity to 10% for each region.

sam_runtime: Config snippet to apply on canary nodes: ```
# runtime canary flags
runtime.flags = ["kvcache_preload=true", "continuous_batching=auto", "kvcache_warmup_timeout=30s"]
```

kevin_release: Do we need an SDK pin for older clients while runtime moves? I want to avoid client-side incompat.

sam_runtime: No SDK pin required; this is a runtime behavior change. SDK 2.x and newer include the X-Runtime-Version header so we can trace. If anyone is on an unsupported client we will see the header missing and can correlate.

maria_ops: Rollback playbook (keep handy): ```
1) deploy-bot rollback <region> --to=runtime:3.1.9
2) run smoke for 5m, confirm latency back to baseline
3) pause remaining stages and open incident
```

deploy-bot: Note: automatic incident if error rate >1% sustained for 5m or if deploy-bot receives manual abort. Will also auto-pause subsequent stages on rollback.

kevin_release: Logging/observability ask: include X-Runtime-Version and kvcache_hit_ratio in traces so we can slice by warmup.

sam_runtime: I'll push a tiny middleware patch to add the kvcache_hit_ratio tag to spans and a runtime metrics exporter.

jessica_qa: I'll run the smoke suite and the long-prefix perf job. Plan: post quick pass results within 6m of stage start, full harness at +12m.

maria_ops: Great. If stage is green, deploy-bot will schedule next region at +15m. If we hit rollback criteria, we abort and run the rollback playbook.

kevin_release: Also: release notes tweak — add a compatibility note that warmup characteristics changed with kvcache_preload and recommend customers pining for critical SLAs until tomorrow noon if they prefer.

maria_ops: I'll update the release notes and the support canned response.

jessica_qa: Posting first-stage results to this thread in ~30m after eu-west canary finishes.

maria_ops: Thanks all. Leaving channel open during window. :thumbsup:
